panels.description: Lists the backups triggered or completed within the time range, as chosen in Time Range Applies To. Azure Resource Graph only keeps the last 14 days of backup jobs, so older backups are not listed even if their recovery points have not expired.

value.title: Open the storage account in the Azure Portal

azureResourceGraph.query:
recoveryservicesresources
| where type == 'microsoft.dataprotection/backupvaults/backupjobs'
| where resourceGroup =~ '${AZURE_RESOURCE_GROUP}'
| where properties.operation == 'Backup'
| extend endTime = todatetime(properties.endTime), status = tostring(properties.status), triggered = todatetime(properties.startTime)
| extend finished = status != 'InProgress' and isnotnull(endTime)
| extend completed = iff(finished, endTime, datetime(null))
| where $__timeFilter(${timeField})
| extend dataSourceName = tostring(properties.dataSourceName), recoveryPointId = tostring(properties.extendedInfo.targetRecoverPoint.recoveryPointID)
| mv-expand resourceId = pack_array(tolower(tostring(properties.dataSourceId)), tostring(split(tolower(id), '/backupjobs/')[0])) to typeof(string)
| join kind=leftouter (
	resources
	| where type in ('microsoft.dataprotection/backupvaults', 'microsoft.storage/storageaccounts')
	| where resourceGroup =~ '${AZURE_RESOURCE_GROUP}'
	| project dataPlane = tostring(tags['data-plane']), namespace = strcat('liferay-', tostring(tags['project-id']), '-', tostring(tags['environment-id'])), resourceId = tolower(id)
) on resourceId
| summarize dataPlane = max(dataPlane), namespace = max(namespace) by completed, dataSourceName, finished, id, recoveryPointId, status, triggered
| where namespace == '$environment'
| extend minutes = iff(finished, max_of(toint(round((completed - triggered) / 1m)), 1), int(null))
| order by triggered desc
| project ['Recovery Point ID'] = iff(status in ('Completed', 'CompletedWithWarnings'), recoveryPointId, ''), ['Data Plane'] = dataPlane, ['Storage Account'] = dataSourceName, ['Backup Triggered'] = triggered, ['Backup Completed'] = completed, Duration = case(not(finished), '', minutes >= 60, strcat(minutes / 60, 'h', iff(minutes % 60 < 10, '0', ''), minutes % 60, 'm'), strcat(minutes, 'm')), Status = case(status in ('Completed', 'CompletedWithWarnings'), 'SUCCEEDED', status == 'InProgress', 'IN PROGRESS', status == 'Failed', 'FAILED', toupper(status))

panels.title: Backups

panels.description: Counts the backups that succeeded within the time range, as chosen in Time Range Applies To. Azure Resource Graph only keeps the last 14 days of backup jobs, so older backups are not counted.

azureResourceGraph.query:
recoveryservicesresources
| where type == 'microsoft.dataprotection/backupvaults/backupjobs'
| where resourceGroup =~ '${AZURE_RESOURCE_GROUP}'
| where properties.operation == 'Backup'
| extend endTime = todatetime(properties.endTime), status = tostring(properties.status), triggered = todatetime(properties.startTime)
| extend finished = status != 'InProgress' and isnotnull(endTime)
| extend completed = iff(finished, endTime, datetime(null))
| where $__timeFilter(${timeField})
| where status in ('Cancelled', 'Completed', 'CompletedWithWarnings', 'Failed')
| mv-expand resourceId = pack_array(tolower(tostring(properties.dataSourceId)), tostring(split(tolower(id), '/backupjobs/')[0])) to typeof(string)
| join kind=leftouter (
	resources
	| where type in ('microsoft.dataprotection/backupvaults', 'microsoft.storage/storageaccounts')
	| where resourceGroup =~ '${AZURE_RESOURCE_GROUP}'
	| project namespace = strcat('liferay-', tostring(tags['project-id']), '-', tostring(tags['environment-id'])), resourceId = tolower(id)
) on resourceId
| summarize namespace = max(namespace) by id, status
| where namespace == '$environment'
| where status in ('Completed', 'CompletedWithWarnings')
| summarize ['Successful Runs'] = count()

panels.title: Total Runs

panels.description: Shows the share of finished backups that failed or were cancelled within the time range, as chosen in Time Range Applies To. Azure Resource Graph only keeps the last 14 days of backup jobs, so older backups are not counted.

azureResourceGraph.query:
recoveryservicesresources
| where type == 'microsoft.dataprotection/backupvaults/backupjobs'
| where resourceGroup =~ '${AZURE_RESOURCE_GROUP}'
| where properties.operation == 'Backup'
| extend endTime = todatetime(properties.endTime), status = tostring(properties.status), triggered = todatetime(properties.startTime)
| extend finished = status != 'InProgress' and isnotnull(endTime)
| extend completed = iff(finished, endTime, datetime(null))
| where $__timeFilter(${timeField})
| where status in ('Cancelled', 'Completed', 'CompletedWithWarnings', 'Failed')
| mv-expand resourceId = pack_array(tolower(tostring(properties.dataSourceId)), tostring(split(tolower(id), '/backupjobs/')[0])) to typeof(string)
| join kind=leftouter (
	resources
	| where type in ('microsoft.dataprotection/backupvaults', 'microsoft.storage/storageaccounts')
	| where resourceGroup =~ '${AZURE_RESOURCE_GROUP}'
	| project namespace = strcat('liferay-', tostring(tags['project-id']), '-', tostring(tags['environment-id'])), resourceId = tolower(id)
) on resourceId
| summarize namespace = max(namespace) by id, status
| where namespace == '$environment'
| summarize failed = countif(status !in ('Completed', 'CompletedWithWarnings')), total = count()
| project ['Backup Failure Rate'] = iff(total == 0, real(null), 100.0 * failed / total)

list.description: Whether the time range matches each backup by when it was triggered or by when it completed. A backup still in progress has not completed, so it only matches by when it was triggered.

azureResourceGraph.query:
resources
| where resourceGroup =~ '${AZURE_RESOURCE_GROUP}'
| take 1
| extend cutoff = now() - 14d
| project endTime = strcat(format_datetime(cutoff, 'yyyy-MM-dd'), 'T', format_datetime(cutoff, 'HH:mm:ss'))

resources
| where type == 'microsoft.dataprotection/backupvaults'
| where resourceGroup =~ '${AZURE_RESOURCE_GROUP}'
| where strcat('liferay-', tostring(tags['project-id']), '-', tostring(tags['environment-id'])) == '$environment'
| project name
